name: nodebox-forum-web
description: The NodeBox forum: a Cloudflare Worker (Hono + D1 + R2 + Cloudflare Images).

scripts.dev: npm run build:client && wrangler dev --var MAILER:log --var PUBLIC_URL:http://localhost:8787 --var READ_ONLY:false
scripts.deploy: npm run build:client && npm run db:migrate:remote && wrangler deploy --var GIT_COMMIT:$(git diff --quiet HEAD && git rev-parse HEAD || echo none)
scripts.ci:build: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build:client
scripts.ci:deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply nodebox-forum --remote && wrangler deploy --var GIT_COMMIT:${WORKERS_CI_COMMIT_SHA:-none}
scripts.upload:attachments:remote: CF_ACCOUNT_ID='op://NodeBox/NodeBox Forum/Cloudflare/CF_ACCOUNT_ID' CF_IMAGES_TOKEN='op://NodeBox/NodeBox Forum/Cloudflare/CF_IMAGES_TOKEN' op run -- npm run upload:attachments -- --remote
